title: Maintaining Trap Seals to Block Sewer Gas
description: A P-trap relies on a permanent water seal trapped in its dip to form a barrier against foul sewer gases entering a building. In infrequently used fixtures or warm environments, this water barrier gradually evaporates, breaking the seal and allowing sewer odor and dangerous gases to escape into living spaces. To prevent dry traps, professional plumbers recommend routine flushing, installing automatic trap primers on floor drains, or adding non-evaporating barrier fluids designed for dry-use drains. Maintaining this liquid barrier is critical for indoor air quality and code compliance.

To prevent dry traps, professional plumbers recommend routine flushing, installing automatic trap primers on floor drains, or adding non-evaporating barrier fluids designed for dry-use drains. Maintaining this liquid barrier is critical for indoor air quality and code compliance.
